title: Preliminary verification of the anti-hypoxia mechanism of Gentiana straminea maxim based on UPLC-triple TOF MS/MS and network pharmacology.
authors: Kong, Xiu Mei; Song, Dan; Li, Jie; Jiang, Yi; Zhang, Xiao Ying; Wu, Xiao Jun; Ge, Ming Juan; Xu, Jiao Jiao; Gao, Xiao Min; Zhao, Qin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究藏药麻花秦艽的抗缺氧机制，涉及网络药理学和分子对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Anoxia is characterized by changes in the morphology, metabolism, and function of tissues and organs due to insufficient oxygen supply or oxygen dysfunction. Gentiana straminea Maxim (G.s Maxim) is a traditional Tibetan medicine. Our previous work found that G.s Maxim mediates resistance to hypoxia, and we found that the ethyl acetate extract had the best effect. Nevertheless, the primary anti-hypoxia components and mechanisms of action remain unclear. METHODS: Compounds from the ethyl acetate extraction of G.s Maxim were identified using UPLC-Triple TOF MS/MS. Then Traditional Chinese Medicine Systematic Pharmacology Database was used to filtrate them. Network pharmacology was used to forecast the mechanisms of these compounds. Male specific pathogen-free Sprague Dawley rats were randomly divided into six groups: (1) Control; (2) Model; (3) 228 mg/kg body weight Rhodiola capsules; (4) 6.66 g/kg body weight the G.s Maxim's ethyl acetate extraction; (5) 3.33 g/kg body weight the G.s Maxim's ethyl acetate extraction; (6) 1.67 g/kg body weight the G.s Maxim's ethyl acetate extraction. After administering intragastric ally for 15 consecutive days, an anoxia model was established using a hypobaric oxygen chamber (7000 m, 24 h). Then Histology, enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays, and western blots were performed to determine these compounds' anti-hypoxic effects and mechanisms. Finally, we performed a molecular docking test to test these compounds using Auto Dock. RESULTS: Eight drug-like compounds in G.s Maxim were confirmed using UPLC-Triple TOF MS/MS and Lipinski's rule. The tumor necrosis factor (TNF) signaling pathway, the hypoxia-inducible factor 1 (HIF-1) signaling pathway, and the nuclear factor kappa-B (NF-kappaB) signaling pathway was signaling pathways that G.s Maxim mediated anti-anoxia effects. The critical targets were TNF, Jun proto-oncogene (JUN), tumor protein p53 (TP53), and threonine kinase 1 (AKT1). Animal experiments showed that the ethyl acetate extraction of G.s Maxim ameliorated the hypoxia-induced damage of hippocampal nerve cells in the CA1 region and reversed elevated serum expression of TNF-alpha, IL-6, and NF-kappa B in hypoxic rats. The compound also reduced the expression of HIF-1alpha and p65 and increased the Bcl-2/Bax ratio in brain tissue. These findings suggest that G.s Maxim significantly protects against brain tissue damage in hypoxic rats by suppressing hypoxia-induced apoptosis and inflammation. Ccorosolic acid, oleanolic acid, and ursolic acid had a strong affinity with core targets. CONCLUSIONS: The ethyl acetate extraction of G.s Maxim mediates anti-hypoxic effects, possibly related to inhibiting apoptosis and inflammatory responses through the HIF-1/NF-kappaB pathway. The primary active components might be corosolic, oleanolic, and ursolic acids.
abstract_zh: 背景：缺氧以组织器官因供氧不足或氧利用障碍而发生的形态、代谢及功能变化为特征。粗壮秦艽（Gentiana straminea Maxim, G.s Maxim）是一种传统藏药。我们前期工作发现，G.s Maxim可介导抗缺氧作用，并发现乙酸乙酯提取物效果最佳。然而，其主要抗缺氧成分及作用机制仍不清楚。方法：采用UPLC-Triple TOF MS/MS鉴定G.s Maxim乙酸乙酯提取物中的化合物，随后利用中药系统药理学数据库进行筛选，并通过网络药理学预测这些化合物的作用机制。雄性无特定病原体Sprague Dawley大鼠随机分为六组：（1）对照组；（2）模型组；（3）228 mg/kg体重红景天胶囊组；（4）6.66 g/kg体重G.s Maxim乙酸乙酯提取物组；（5）3.33 g/kg体重G.s Maxim乙酸乙酯提取物组；（6）1.67 g/kg体重G.s Maxim乙酸乙酯提取物组。连续灌胃15天后，利用低压氧舱（7000 m，24 h）建立缺氧模型。随后进行组织学、酶联免疫吸附测定和蛋白质印迹分析，以确定这些化合物的抗缺氧效应及机制。最后，使用Auto Dock进行分子对接测试。结果：通过UPLC-Triple TOF MS/MS和Lipinski规则确认了G.s Maxim中的八种类药化合物。肿瘤坏死因子（TNF）信号通路、缺氧诱导因子1（HIF-1）信号通路和核因子kappa-B（NF-kappaB）信号通路是G.s Maxim介导抗缺氧效应的信号通路。关键靶点为TNF、Jun原癌基因（JUN）、肿瘤蛋白p53（TP53）和苏氨酸激酶1（AKT1）。动物实验表明，G.s Maxim乙酸乙酯提取物改善了缺氧诱导的海马CA1区神经细胞损伤，并逆转了缺氧大鼠血清中TNF-alpha、IL-6和NF-kappa B的升高表达。该化合物还降低了脑组织中HIF-1alpha和p65的表达，并增加了Bcl-2/Bax比值。这些发现表明，G.s Maxim通过抑制缺氧诱导的凋亡和炎症，显著保护缺氧大鼠的脑组织损伤。科罗索酸、齐墩果酸和熊果酸与核心靶点具有强亲和力。结论：G.s Maxim乙酸乙酯提取物介导抗缺氧效应，可能与其通过HIF-1/NF-kappaB通路抑制凋亡和炎症反应有关。主要活性成分可能为科罗索酸、齐墩果酸和熊果酸。
